sentences.en: You may have heard that money can't always buy happiness.
sentences.zh: 你可能听说过，金钱并不总能买到幸福。

sentences.en: Well, that's especially true for children from affluent families who may feel pressure to succeed, get good grades, and be model children.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于富裕家庭的孩子来说，这尤其在理，他们可能会感到要成功、考高分、做模范儿童的压力。

sentences.en: In this episode, we talk with one psychologist who is teaching her own children how to be happy without relying on money.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们采访了一位心理学家，她正在教自己的孩子如何在不依赖金钱的情况下获得快乐。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学话语》。

sentences.en: Sunia Luther is a psychology professor at Arizona State University.
sentences.zh: 苏妮娅·卢瑟是亚利桑那州立大学的心理学教授。

sentences.en: She has studied the vulnerability and resilience of youth in poverty and children and families affected by mental illness.
sentences.zh: 她曾研究过贫困青年以及受精神疾病影响的儿童和家庭的脆弱性与韧性。

sentences.en: Her most recent work has focused on children in affluent communities.
sentences.zh: 她最近的工作重点是富裕社区的儿童。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Luther.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，卢瑟博士。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Is depression very common among children from affluent families?
sentences.zh: 富裕家庭的孩子抑郁症很常见吗？

sentences.en: How do these depression rates compare to children from lower-income families?
sentences.zh: 这些抑郁症发病率与低收入家庭的孩子相比如何？

sentences.en: What we found, Audrey, is rates of about 1.5 to 2.5 times as high as national normative samples.
sentences.zh: 奥黛丽，我们发现发病率大约是全国常模样本的1.5到2.5倍。

sentences.en: Of problems like depressive symptoms, anxiety symptoms, and even higher rates of problems of substance use that would be alcohol, marijuana, and even hard drugs.
sentences.zh: 诸如抑郁症状、焦虑症状之类的问题，甚至还有更高比率的物质滥用问题，包括酒精、大麻甚至是硬毒品。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So when you were studying this, was it a surprising finding to you?
sentences.zh: 那么在研究这个时，你觉得这是一个令人惊讶的发现吗？

sentences.en: Oh, it was awfully surprising.
sentences.zh: 哦，极其令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Actually, I stumbled upon these findings quite by accident.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我完全是偶然发现这些结果的。

sentences.en: My first study on upper-middle-class youth was conducted essentially to look for a comparison group for inner-city kids.
sentences.zh: 我对中上阶层青少年的第一项研究，本质上是为了寻找内城儿童的对照组。

sentences.en: And while doing this comparison, we found, much to my surprise, that the so-called privileged or rich kids were doing much more poorly.
sentences.zh: 而在做这个对比时，令我大吃一惊的是，我们发现所谓的特权阶层或有钱的孩子情况要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: Again, mostly on substance use, but also on depression and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，主要是在物质滥用方面，同时也体现在抑郁和焦虑上。

sentences.en: So that was way back in the late 90s, and since then we've followed that trail and replicated these findings over and over again.
sentences.zh: 所以那还是在90年代末，从那以后，我们一直顺着这条线索，一次又一次地重复验证了这些发现。

sentences.en: What have you found to be the reason behind these high numbers?
sentences.zh: 你发现这些高数字背后的原因是什么？

sentences.en: Can you describe the research a little bit more in detail on this area?
sentences.zh: 你能更详细地描述一下该领域的这项研究吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: People have a tendency to say, oh, it's the parents.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种倾向，会说，哦，都是父母的问题。

sentences.en: And I cannot think of something that is more misguided than to pick on either the parents or the schools.
sentences.zh: 我想不出还有什么比把矛头指向父母或学校更被误导的了。

sentences.en: There is not a single unitary factor that will explain all this.
sentences.zh: 没有任何单一的因素可以解释这一切。

sentences.en: It is a problem that derives from multiple levels.
sentences.zh: 这是一个多层面导致的问题。

sentences.en: Let's start with just American society and what our values are.
sentences.zh: 让我们从美国社会及其价值观开始说起。

sentences.en: More is better.
sentences.zh: 越多越好。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请说。

sentences.en: The title of my last chapter, I can, therefore I muSt.
sentences.zh: 我最后一章的标题是：我能，所以我必能。

sentences.en: If you can, therefore you muSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你能，因此你必能。

sentences.en: Achieve more and move ahead.
sentences.zh: 取得更多成就，不断向前。

sentences.en: So this starts at the level of society.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切始于社会层面。

sentences.en: Then it goes into the schools.
sentences.zh: 然后进入学校。

sentences.en: It goes into the universities.
sentences.zh: 进入大学。

sentences.en: What is it that admissions people value in making their selections?
sentences.zh: 招生人员在做选择时看重什么？

sentences.en: It's all about accomplishments and achievements.
sentences.zh: 全都是关于成就和成果的。

sentences.en: So the bottom line is, it is not just the family.
sentences.zh: 所以底线是，这不仅仅是家庭的问题。

sentences.en: It is not just the child.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是孩子的问题。

sentences.en: It is the culture we live in, the universities, the schools, everybody coming together to reinforce that one big message.
sentences.zh: 这是我们生活的文化，是大学、学校，所有人聚在一起强化那一个巨大的信息。

sentences.en: If you can, therefore you muSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你能，因此你必能。

sentences.en: Do not stop.
sentences.zh: 不要停下。

sentences.en: So how does this relate to the problems of depression, substance use?
sentences.zh: 那么这与抑郁和物质滥用问题有什么关系？

sentences.en: Pressure to achieve.
sentences.zh: 对成就的渴望。

sentences.en: You see, if your sense of self-worth gets tied into how much you can accomplish, two things happen.
sentences.zh: 你看，如果你的自我价值感与你能取得多少成就绑定在一起，就会发生两件事。

sentences.en: One is, if you don't accomplish, you feel small, inadequate, lousy, what have you.
sentences.zh: 一是如果你没有取得成就，你就会觉得自己渺小、无能、糟糕，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And the other is, you live in a state of fear of not achieving.
sentences.zh: 另一是，你生活在对无法取得成就的恐惧状态中。

sentences.en: If I can tell myself I'm a good person because I'm a good mother, a good friend, that's one thing.
sentences.zh: 如果我可以告诉自己我是一个好人，因为我是一个好母亲、好朋友，那是另一回事。

sentences.en: If I tell myself I'm a good person to the degree that I get that next grant or I get famous or I get these accolades,
sentences.zh: 如果我告诉自己我是一个好人，程度取决于我是否得到了下一笔资助、是否成名或得到了这些荣誉，

sentences.en: I'm living in fear, these are things that are not as much in my control as are things like being a good mother or being a good friend.
sentences.zh: 我便生活在恐惧中，这些事情并不像做个好母亲或好朋友那样在我的控制之中。

sentences.en: So living in this constant state of tension, fear, if I don't achieve, who will I be, is something that puts us in a state of anxiety and the failures and a state of depression.
sentences.zh: 因此，生活在这种持续的紧张、恐惧状态中——如果我不成功，我会是谁——会让我们陷入焦虑状态，而失败则会让我们陷入抑郁状态。

sentences.en: To medicate, to self-medicate these feelings of anxiety and depression, unfortunately, a lot of our kids are turning to drugs and alcohol, as are we, their parents.
sentences.zh: 为了自我治疗这些焦虑和抑郁的情绪，不幸的是，我们的许多孩子开始转向毒品和酒精，就像我们这些做父母的一样。

sentences.en: Is your advice that affluent parents simply lower the pressures they put on their children, or how do they go about to balance the need for success versus mental health?
sentences.zh: 你的建议是让富裕父母直接降低对孩子施加的压力，还是他们该如何在成功需求与心理健康之间取得平衡？

sentences.en: In terms of advice for parents, I'm thinking back on when we had first started doing in-depth research on families in poverty.
sentences.zh: 就给父母的建议而言，我回想起我们刚开始对贫困家庭进行深入研究的时候。

sentences.en: Now, mothers in poverty living in inner-city areas where there's a lot of violence and so on,
sentences.zh: 现在，生活在内城地区、充斥着大量暴力等现象的贫困母亲们，

sentences.en: they have to work extra hard to make sure that their children do not hang out after dark in places that are dangerous.
sentences.zh: 她们必须付出额外的努力，以确保孩子们天黑后不在危险的地方闲逛。

sentences.en: It almost becomes extra important for them to pay attention to this front.
sentences.zh: 对她们来说，在这方面保持警惕几乎变得格外重要。

sentences.en: In much the same way, we parents in upper-middle-class societies have to work extra hard at ensuring that our children have a balanced value system,
sentences.zh: 同理，我们身处中上阶层社会的父母也必须加倍努力，确保我们的孩子拥有平衡的价值观，

sentences.en: that they are not all about who can I be, how far can I go, at whatever cost, but they are equally, if not more, invested in how can I be a decent, kind person,
sentences.zh: 让他们不把全部精力放在“我可以成为谁”、“我能走多远”并不惜一切代价上，而是同样甚至更加投入于“我如何成为一个正派、善良的人”，

sentences.en: invested in the good of humanity and not just myself.
sentences.zh: 致力于人类的福祉而不仅仅是他们自己。

sentences.en: So to summarize that, just as the inner-city parents must work extra hard to keep their children physically safe and out of trouble with gangs,
sentences.zh: 总结一下，就像内城父母必须加倍努力以确保孩子的人身安全、远离帮派麻烦一样，

sentences.en: we in upper-middle-class white-collar families need to work extra hard to make sure our children do not get swept away in this feeling of I must do more
sentences.zh: 我们这些中上阶层白领家庭需要加倍努力，确保我们的孩子不会被“我必须做得更多”这种感觉所吞没，

sentences.en: and stay grounded more in decency, kindness, and true compassion, concern for humanity.
sentences.zh: 并在正派、善良以及真正的同情心和对人类的关怀上更加脚踏实地。

sentences.en: And that, in turn, will affect their own well-being.
sentences.zh: 而这反过来又会影响他们自己的幸福感。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: There are more and more studies now saying if you are good and compassionate and kind, that this helps your own well-being.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的研究表明，如果你善良、富有同情心且温和，这会有助于你自己的幸福感。

sentences.en: Altruism helps you feel better about yourself.
sentences.zh: 利他主义能让你对自己的感觉更好。

sentences.en: There are studies showing psychological well-being is better.
sentences.zh: 有研究表明，心理健康状况会更好。

sentences.en: There are physiological studies that show this.
sentences.zh: 有生理学研究也证明了这一点。

sentences.en: So yes, doing for others makes you feel good.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，为他人付出能让你感觉良好。

sentences.en: Well, that's one thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一回事。

sentences.en: And doing for others also, obviously, strengthens your connections with others.
sentences.zh: 而且为他人付出显然也会加强你与他人的联系。

sentences.en: So just the sheer act of generosity of altruism is going to make you feel better yourself.
sentences.zh: 因此，仅仅是慷慨和利他主义的纯粹行为，就会让你自己感觉更好。

sentences.en: And the second thing is that you're going to strengthen your relationships with the people for whom you are doing good.
sentences.zh: 第二点是，你将加强与那些你为之做好事的人的关系。

sentences.en: They will appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 他们会感激的。

sentences.en: And there's another stronger social network, link in your social network.
sentences.zh: 你的社交网络中会有另一个更强大的社交网络链接。

sentences.en: What other behavioral mental health problems do you see among children and parents of more privileged families?
sentences.zh: 在更有特权的家庭的孩子和父母身上，你还看到了哪些其他的行为与心理健康问题？

sentences.en: Anything beyond depression, substance abuse?
sentences.zh: 除了抑郁和药物滥用之外还有吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: We have, in order, if I were to go in order, the problems that we've seen among upper-middle-class kids is starting with alcohol and drug use, depression, anxiety.
sentences.zh: 如果我们按顺序排列的话，我们在中上阶层孩子身上看到的问题依次是：酒精和药物滥用、抑郁、焦虑。

sentences.en: Now, here's one that really startled me.
sentences.zh: 现在，有一个真正让我大吃一惊的问题。

sentences.en: High levels of rule-breaking.
sentences.zh: 高水平的违规行为。

sentences.en: Now, we're talking about random acts of delinquency.
sentences.zh: 现在我们讨论的是随机的违法行为。

sentences.en: We found levels are comparable, actually, to levels in inner-city settings.
sentences.zh: 我们发现其水平实际上与内城环境中的水平相当。

sentences.en: The only difference is the inner-city kids are doing things like carrying a gun or getting into a fight and so on, which could potentially be in self-protection and gangs.
sentences.zh: 唯一的区别是，内城孩子做的事情比如携带枪支或打架等等，可能出于自卫和帮派需要。

sentences.en: Our upper-middle-class kids are doing things like stealing from a friend or stealing from a parent or defacing property, as I said, random acts of delinquency.
sentences.zh: 我们的中上阶层孩子做的事比如偷朋友的东西、偷父母的东西或毁坏财产，正如我所说，是随机的违法行为。

sentences.en: And these rates are much higher, again, two to two and a half times as high as average rates in America.
sentences.zh: 而且这些比率要高得多，再次达到美国平均水平的两到两倍半。

sentences.en: Then there is envy, particularly among our girls.
sentences.zh: 然后是嫉妒，特别是在我们的女孩当中。

sentences.en: Levels of envy of peers are much higher than we find among inner-city girls or boys or upper-middle-class boys.
sentences.zh: 对同龄人的嫉妒水平远高于我们在内城女孩、男孩或中上阶层男孩中发现的水平。

sentences.en: For some reason, our girls are showing problems in multiple domains.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，我们的女孩在多个领域都表现出问题。

sentences.en: So it's not just the depression, the anxiety, the typically female problems, but also the more typically male problems of drug and alcohol use and rule-breaking.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅是抑郁、焦虑这些通常的女性问题，还有药物和酒精滥用以及违规这些通常的男性问题。

sentences.en: It's very troubling.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人担忧。

sentences.en: How can parents teach their kids to have this balanced value system?
sentences.zh: 父母如何教导孩子建立这种平衡的价值观？

sentences.en: And my answer, almost invariably, is, you know what?
sentences.zh: 而我的回答几乎千篇一律：你知道吗？

sentences.en: We really can't teach.
sentences.zh: 我们真的教不了。

sentences.en: What we have to do is model.
sentences.zh: 我们必须做的是树立榜样。

sentences.en: So I can tell my kids till the cows come home, listen, be a good person.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以对我的孩子们唠叨个没完：听着，要做一个好人。

sentences.en: But if I'm driving past people, cutting the grocery line, being inconsiderate to their teachers, to the household gardener or whatever, that's what the children pick up.
sentences.zh: 但如果我开车从人群身边开过、在杂货店插队、对他们的老师、家里的园丁或其他什么人不体贴，那才是孩子们学到的东西。

sentences.en: They don't pick up what you say to them.
sentences.zh: 他们学到的不是你对他们说的话。

sentences.en: They pick up what you do.
sentences.zh: 他们学到的是你做的事。

sentences.en: The second thing is we need to be very conscious about our own values.
sentences.zh: 第二件事是我们需要对我们自己的价值观保持高度警觉。

sentences.en: See, it's very easy for us to say, no, I really want my child to be a good person.
sentences.zh: 你看，我们很容易说：不，我真的很希望我的孩子成为一个好人。

sentences.en: But take a step back and say, if your child did not make the starters in the basketball team, if the child did not get into the advanced reading group,
sentences.zh: 但退一步想想，如果你的孩子没有进入篮球队的主力阵容，如果孩子没有进入高级阅读组，

sentences.en: might you, even with a slight raised eyebrow, a slight gesture, be conveying, I'm disappointed?
sentences.zh: 你是否甚至带着微微扬起的眉毛、一个细微的手势，在传达出“我很失望”的信息？

sentences.en: You see, we fall into this trap without realizing it sometimes, that we are conveying to them that, but it's not quite as direct or blatant as saying,
sentences.zh: 你看，有时我们在不知不觉中就陷入了这个陷阱，我们在向他们传达那种情绪，尽管它没有那么直接或露骨，比如直接说，

sentences.en: oh, my God, you've got five A's, why the one B?
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，你得了五个A，为什么唯独一个B？

sentences.en: It can be much more subtle and say, just, yeah, well, that's hopefully nice.
sentences.zh: 它可以微妙得多，比如仅仅说，哦，好吧，希望这还算不错。

sentences.en: And what did Jimmy get?
sentences.zh: 吉米得了多少分？

sentences.en: Or, you know, how did he do?
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，他考得怎么样？

sentences.en: Giving off impressions of competition.
sentences.zh: 散发出竞争的印象。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So we have, but that means in turn that we need to look deep within ourselves.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须这样做，但这反过来意味着我们需要深刻审视自己的内心。

sentences.en: See, many of us in these upper middle class families, we are hardworking.
sentences.zh: 你看，我们这些中上阶层家庭的许多人都是努力工作的人。

sentences.en: We've reached levels of professional accomplishment and so on that mean a great deal to us.
sentences.zh: 我们已经达到了对我们意义重大的专业成就等水平。

sentences.en: If I feel like my work, my career, brings me such enormous gratification, somewhere subconsciously, otherwise I want my child to have a very successful career path too
sentences.zh: 如果我觉得我的工作、我的职业给我带来了如此巨大的满足感，在某种潜意识或其他层面上，我也会希望我的孩子走上一条非常成功的职业道路，

sentences.en: so that he or she can have the same gratification.
sentences.zh: 这样他或她也能获得同样的满足感。

sentences.en: That can lead us to, again, inadvertently doing and saying things that we don't mean to.
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致我们再次无意中做出和说出我们并非本意的话。

sentences.en: Yes, it's lovely if my child has a PhD, but you know what, there are other things in life
sentences.zh: 是的，如果我的孩子有博士学位固然很好，但你知道吗，生活中还有其他事情，

sentences.en: as I often tell young people, including my own children when they're applying to college, you'll get an education.
sentences.zh: 正如我经常对年轻人所说的那样，包括我自己的孩子在申请大学时，你会受到教育的。

sentences.en: It's all right, you'll get an education.
sentences.zh: 没关系，你会接受教育的。

sentences.en: Life does not begin and end at being at the top.
sentences.zh: 生活并不始于也不终于站在金字塔尖。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Dr. Luther.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，卢瑟博士。

sentences.en: I appreciate you taking the time.
sentences.zh: 感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It was my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: To listen to more podcast episodes, please visit our website at speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 要收听更多播客节目，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's
sentences.zh: 由美国心理学协会制作的

sentences.en: Speaking of Psychology,
sentences.zh: 《心理学话语》

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
